title: Stage 01 Generation Plan
description: The stable mathematical and pedagogical plan that controls every later generation stage.

scenarioId.description: Stable positive scenario identifier shared by every stage.

scenarioName.description: Concise homepage name for the scenario.

concept.description: The requested calculus concept, narrowed only when necessary.

testPoint.description: The single core skill assessed by this problem set.

necessaryCalculation.description: One to three indispensable calculations that must appear in complete solutions.

representationType.description: Whether learners construct a model or select a fit for measurements.

visualPolicy.description: Whether the generated set requires scatter data.

calculusRequired.description: Confirms that calculus is genuinely necessary.

justification.description: Why the decision cannot be made by common sense or elementary arithmetic.

shortcutBlocked.description: The visible-maximum, raw-sum, endpoint, or similar shortcut that the design prevents.

misconceptions.description: Concept-specific misconception catalog used to construct wrong-answer trajectories.

requiredWrongAnswerTrajectory.description: The misconception trajectory that Stage 07 must include.

profile.description: Normalized concept profile controlling defaults and misconception pools. Use custom for other narrow Calculus 1 concepts.

variant.description: Selected profile variant, used to avoid repetitive scenarios.

step.description: Solution step at which the misconception occurs.

downstreamRule.description: How later work must remain consistent with this one error.

$comment: scenarioId must remain identical across every stage. visualPolicy must be NO_PLOT for CONSTRUCTED and SCATTER_REQUIRED for FITTED. Critical-points plans must require a trajectory that solves f(x)=0 instead of analyzing f'(x).
